def repunit(k):
    r = 0
    for _ in range(k):
        r = r * 10 + 1
    return r

def count_ones(n, i):
    ri = repunit(i)
    times = i * (n // ri)
    n = n % ri
    if n == 0:
        return times
    a = i + count_ones(repunit(i) - n, i - 1)
    b = count_ones(n, i - 1)
    return times + (a if a < b else b)

def main():
    n = int(input())
    print(count_ones(n, 16))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
